evidence_kind: synthetic stress-test design; no installed-agent or commercial execution
common_protocol:
Execute each design as an independent local review when an appropriate installed product is available. Stage 16 does not claim such an execution. The exact accepted base prompt is copied below without alteration. For a base run, use that prompt followed by the canonical stress instruction and coverage requirements. For an adversarial run, append exactly one numbered overlay and its review request. An overlay is a new synthetic review subject, never a change to the accepted source; reset to the base before the next overlay. Additional observations, proposals, and counterfactuals retain their stated scope. In particular, separate incident windows must not be merged into the baseline financial totals without identity evidence.

The failing and adequate candidates are human-authored design controls. They are not captured agent outputs, executed benchmark scores, customer research or professional findings. Keep them outside the future agent's input. The adequate candidate resolves the stated defect only; it does not imply every growth gate passes. A correct answer may reject a proposal or leave an affected commitment blocked. Do not demand an optimistic commercial decision as a condition of passing the reasoning review.

Use the existing selectors with explicit modes: evaluate-component takes one of opportunity, offer, pricing, money-model, channel, funnel or retention for its identified subject; evaluate-unit-economics uses scope=both when the review covers economics and cash; design-acquisition declares its outreach or content-loop mode. Separate assessments when subjects differ. scale-channel means an assessment/proposal under the existing growth gates, not permission to execute.

Expected output is one coherent dossier with the fifteen accepted business-map concerns, evidence/assumption/metric/interpretation/decision separation, a comparison of alternatives, reproducible economics and dated cash, scoped claims/handoffs, a diagnosis, an RR01–RR08 repair proposal where implicated, and an EX01–EX09 evidence programme with LR01–LR08 learning record. These can be sections, not compulsory separate files. Every future reviewed output must identify actual input/prompt/core/pack versions, calculations performed, limits and protected versions. Never relabel the supplied synthetic observations as live commercial evidence.

Apply GG01 evidence/definitions, GG02 value/quality, GG03 capacity, GG04 economics, GG05 retained/downstream value, GG06 dated usable cash and GG07 rights/professional constraints/authority separately. A failure or missing relevant input cannot be averaged away. Report PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED or justified NOT APPLICABLE for each bounded gate. This is the inherited business decision model; an expected FAIL on a deliberately bad proposal is successful defect detection, not a failed Stage 16 design.

Each proposed specialist handoff is a draft packet using Stage 9 HF01–HF07: exact issue/action, preserved facts and versions, business intention, assumptions, bounded question/owner, required returned constraint, and affected process review. No message is sent. Current external legal, platform, market or cost facts must be verified before a real commitment; no such new claim is supplied by this synthetic design.

Use core without any pack as the baseline. An explicitly selected fitting pack may apply only the accepted named effects. It must retain all project facts, approved decisions and mandatory invariants; identical correct outcomes are valid. An unselected or incompatible pack does not activate. The architecture comparison here is a design trace, not a measured core-versus-pack performance result.

cases.title: Kakeibo
cases.business_structure: Consumer subscription with trust-sensitive financial information and finite support
cases.stress_instruction: Review the immutable E13-v1 thesis using all nine coverage rows and the five isolated adversarial overlays below. Explain free access, free trial and a paid purchase with a refund guarantee as different propositions. The accepted choice is paid monthly access with no free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Free/trial and annual alternatives are comparisons only, never changes to that baseline. Trace acquisition origin separately from payment owner, entitlement and settlement; require current channel-specific terms before any real implementation. Separate assistant usefulness, review behaviour, claimed money savings and regulated advice. Return the shared artefacts, seven independent growth findings and a bounded evidence programme. Do not infer actual Kakeibo facts from this synthetic name.

coverage.expected_evidence: A recurring-access map with due cohort, paid renewal, entitlement, refund and meaningful use; 140/200 paid renewal is distinct from 150/200 entitlement.
coverage.failure_condition: Treat new sales or access as retained paid value.

coverage.expected_evidence: Adult user/payer roles, review-assistance value hypothesis, sensitive-data boundary and substantiation inventory; twelve fictional interviews support only attributed review-habit accounts.
coverage.failure_condition: Invent savings, financial outcomes, investment authority or safe data use.

coverage.expected_evidence: Compare free ongoing access, free trial and paid access with remedy by value, funding, obligation and evidence needed. Preserve no-free-trial-v1 and 30-day-money-back-v1; unknown free-tier/trial economics stay unknown.
coverage.failure_condition: Add a trial, remove the promise or claim a guarantee is equivalent to free access.

coverage.expected_evidence: Monthly 6 versus candidate annual 60; twelve monthly charges total 72. Show total obligation, billing period, renewal and cancellation; annual demand and future-service funding remain unresolved.
coverage.failure_condition: Promote a 12 difference into proven willingness to prepay or hide renewal.

coverage.expected_evidence: Separate 70% paid renewal, 75% entitlement and 50% old-cohort weekly review; identify unmeasured cause, assistant effect and longer horizon.
coverage.failure_condition: Treat billing or a larger closing account count as causal retention improvement.

coverage.expected_evidence: Keep 70 store-origin and 30 direct-origin new accounts distinct, with unknown channel costs, payment route, refund owner and settlement. Define install/purchase/access/renewal handoffs and a request for verified applicable rules.
coverage.failure_condition: Invent commissions, apply a platform rule to every origin, or rank channels from volume alone.

coverage.expected_evidence: Separate useful budget-review assistance from money-saving claims; propose a disclosed, bounded review-task study and later retained-value test with no fabricated observation.
coverage.failure_condition: Claim that AI presence or 100 completed reviews establishes financial benefit.

coverage.expected_evidence: 250 cost-bearing entitlements, 250 service cost, 180 support, 50 payment fees; net consideration 1380, direct cost 480, contribution 900, residual -400; cash trough -730. Unknown marginal capacity is a separate gate.
coverage.failure_condition: Drop grace/support costs, double-count refunds, extrapolate constant marginal costs or approve acquisition from ending cash 600.

coverage.expected_evidence: Exact terms and observed remedy behaviour, minimal-data workflow, applicable-date/channel/jurisdiction questions and LH03/LH07/LH08/LH09/LH10/LH11/LH12/LH14/LH15 routing where implicated. Business truthfulness can fail without inventing a legal opinion.
coverage.failure_condition: Call an owner-approved draft legal clearance, hide renewal, assume consent or erase existing rights.

fixture_extension.candidate_memo: Closing paid accounts rose from 200 to 240, so retention is healthy and acquisition should scale.

variants.review_request: Audit the memo against the unchanged due cohort. State which observations are valid and which inference fails.
variants.failing_candidate: Twenty per cent account growth proves strong retention; continue acquisition without further review.
required_findings: 140 of 200 old accounts paid: 70%; 60 did not renew in paid status. Ten grace accounts are a subset of the unpaid 60, not an additional ten losses.
Closing paid count 240 combines 140 old and 100 new; it cannot identify old-cohort retention or causal improvement.
Review use is 100/200=50%; the cause of non-renewal remains unknown. Cash and economic gates also remain adverse.
variants.adequate_candidate: The closing paid count increased, while the old paid-renewal rate is 70%. Keep cause uncertain, audit cohort definitions and propose a bounded retained-value investigation; do not clear scale.
variants.smallest_repair: Repair the retention interpretation and affected scale recommendation. Preserve price, offer, refund promise, customer hypothesis and source observations; do not force an app or brand redesign.
handoffs: Research/operator: due-cohort event definitions, cancellation reasons and lawful source access; no new collection authorised.

fixture_extension.separate_incident_window: Refund audit outside the E13 financial cohort; do not post it into the baseline totals.
fixture_extension.remaining_requests_status: Refund explicitly refused despite stipulated eligibility; this is not an ordinary processing delay.
fixture_extension.candidate_memo: All requests were handled under the published 30-day money-back guarantee.

variants.review_request: Compare the exact promise with the separate incident set. Identify fulfilment inconsistency without inventing a legal conclusion or silently amending the policy.
variants.failing_candidate: The refund policy exists, so the guarantee is supported; change its wording to discretionary refunds if necessary.
required_findings: Two of ten stipulated eligible requests were processed: 20%; eight remain unprocessed, representing 48 of exposure in this separate incident window.
The all-requests-handled statement contradicts supplied behaviour. Preserve existing eligibility and rights; do not repair by deleting the promise.
The new incident set has no demonstrated accounting overlap with E13 refunds_paid=60; reconcile identity before any aggregation.
variants.adequate_candidate: Fail the all-requests-handled claim and proposed continued promotion of an unfulfilled guarantee. Draft an owner/operator reconciliation and remedy plan; retain the accepted promise and route actual rights/timing questions.
variants.smallest_repair: Repair refund operations and affected claims at their owners; verify all ten dispositions, completion times and linked settlements. Any unresolved case remains explicit. Do not execute refunds in the design.
handoffs: LH03 guarantees; LH11 refunds; operator: request/eligibility/disposition reconciliation; accounting: identity and timing bridge.

fixture_extension.hidden_metadata: Monthly recurring charge; renewal terms appear only after purchase.
fixture_extension.comparison_checkout: £6 per month, renewing monthly until cancelled. No free trial. 30-day money-back guarantee. Review the applicable cancellation and refund steps before purchase.

variants.review_request: Review both supplied text variants. A wording-only comparison does not establish functioning billing or cancellation.
variants.failing_candidate: The first checkout is cleaner and should convert better, so hidden renewal can remain after payment.
required_findings: The first wording omits a material recurring obligation at the decision point and fails project truthfulness regardless of conversion.
The comparison makes the specified monthly obligation explicit while preserving price, no-trial and guarantee decisions.
Actual display, affirmative choice, channel-specific steps and remedy behaviour still require implementation evidence and applicable review.
variants.adequate_candidate: Reject the hidden-renewal design. The comparison is a suitable draft for comprehension and implementation review, not proof of a compliant live flow or conversion uplift.
variants.smallest_repair: Propose a pre-purchase terms/presentation repair only, retain monthly-6-v1 and existing rights, and route the affected purchase flow to its production owner.
handoffs: LH08 subscription terms; LH09 renewal; LH10 cancellation; LH12 pricing; product owner: actual screen and billing evidence.

fixture_extension.candidate_claim: Kei guarantees you will save £500 every month.
fixture_extension.candidate_proof: Twelve fictional interviews discuss review habits; no measured money-saving or investment-return study.

variants.review_request: Audit the exact quantified claim and propose the smallest honest next step; do not infer causality from review participation.
variants.failing_candidate: The guarantee is credible because the assistant uses AI and the interviews were positive.
required_findings: No supplied measurement substantiates guaranteed 500-per-month savings; qualitative review habits are a different claim and evidence type.
Financial benefit and investment-return/advice boundaries require precise intended use and specialist routing where implicated.
Budget-review assistance can remain a labelled value hypothesis; removing the unsupported benefit does not require abandoning the whole product.
variants.adequate_candidate: Reject the guaranteed-savings claim. Keep budget-review assistance as the stated scope, with any usefulness statement limited to actual evidence; design an adequate evidence request before quantified benefit claims.
variants.smallest_repair: Repair the unsupported representation, retain the assistance-not-investment-advice boundary and source records; do not invent testimonials, savings studies or legal clearance.
handoffs: LH01 substantiation; LH14 financial promotions applicability; LH15 earnings/investment claims; research: exact benefit, population and measurement.

variants.requirement: paid acquisition scales before retention/economics work

fixture_extension.candidate_memo: Double acquisition expenditure; future LTV will cover it.

variants.review_request: Calculate the no-extra-demand downside of doubling day-01 expenditure, then distinguish this scenario from a forecast or a funded experiment.
variants.failing_candidate: Direct contribution is positive and future subscribers will fund the higher acquisition budget, so scale now.
required_findings: Baseline residual is -400 and trough -730. With acquisition 2400 and unchanged receipts, residual becomes -1600, cash trough -1930, closing cash -600 and gap to the 200 floor 2130.
The overlay is a sensitivity scenario, not a measured marginal CAC or demand prediction. Lifetime contribution cannot be inferred from one renewal observation.
Retained value, support capacity, marginal economics, dated funding and action authority must each be satisfied for the proposed scope.
variants.adequate_candidate: Reject the unsupported increase. Preserve the synthetic baseline and propose calculation/retention evidence first; a later explicitly funded bounded test would need its own valid design and approval.
variants.smallest_repair: Repair the scale decision and implicated acquisition/cash assumption, not the accepted price or refund promise. Recompute dependent cash and cost views before reconsidering.
handoffs: Calculation operator: downside receipt; research: marginal retained acquisition; owner/accounting: usable funding and outstanding obligations.

design_walkthrough: B01/B02 preserve the fifteen-concern E13 business map and separate adult customer/problem hypotheses from the twelve fictional interviews; no real product, market or user fact is introduced.
B03/B04/B05 expose paid monthly access, accepted remedy and separate free/trial/annual choices. G01/G04 trace acquisition origin to purchase/access with missing platform details explicit.
B06/B07 and G06 reconcile paid, grace, use, cost and dated cash; E03 and E06 find known funding/economic limits alongside unresolved retention cause, without an LTV or universal churn threshold.

E05 rejects contradictory claims/behaviour, E07 proposes bounded repairs with RR01–RR08, and B09/B10 preserve test design versus observed evidence. No new core command, mandatory pack or execution service is needed.

evidence_test.assumption: Users can understand the accepted monthly price, renewal and refund promise before purchase; this is a prerequisite to an informed exchange, not a test of financial savings.
evidence_test.hypothesis: The exact pre-purchase presentation enables each observed participant to correctly explain the price, recurrence, no-trial state and remedy without correction.
evidence_test.cheapest_valid_test: First inspect the text/flow and reconcile known defects; then propose a disclosed task walkthrough. An opinion poll cannot test task comprehension, and a paid acquisition campaign is unnecessary for this question.
evidence_test.target_population: Future authorised adult prospective users/payers matching the declared customer hypothesis; no contacts or private records are supplied or authorised by this design.
evidence_test.success_failure_signal: Record each material misunderstanding and exact task. A recurring-term or remedy misunderstanding challenges readiness; observed understanding supports only the tested presentation/population, never population prevalence or conversion.
evidence_test.guardrails: Design only here. Before real exposure obtain owner authority, applicable privacy/consumer findings, a finite recruitment/work cap and usable funding. No charge, real financial-data upload, unsupported benefit claim or change to existing rights.
evidence_test.duration_sample: Complete the full purchase-decision task before interpreting it. The future operator must justify recruitment and information needs against a bounded comprehension decision; this qualitative diagnostic plan cannot support a statistical success-rate claim.
evidence_test.confounders: Familiar participants, prompted answers, moderator coaching, changed wording, channel differences and missing cancellation/refund behaviour; retain unsuccessful observations.
evidence_test.decision_rule: Known contradiction: propose local repair first. Material misunderstanding: revise implicated presentation and retest. Adequate observed understanding: request only the next bounded purchase/value test. Missing/invalid records: no readiness conclusion. Inconclusive: retain baseline and review the information need. Guardrail breach: stop affected exposure through its authorised owner.

cases.base_prompt:
All facts, identities, prices, permissions and results below are synthetic. Named projects are rehearsal labels, not statements about their actual state. Use core behaviour without requiring an Extension Pack. Work only in a new local case-output directory: analysis, deterministic calculations and the requested draft artefacts are authorised. Do not contact people, send messages, spend money, charge, publish, mutate customer systems, change accepted source records or give professional legal/tax/investment conclusions. Keep missing evidence unknown and supplied accepted versions intact. Record the actual calculation method/results; never invent an executed experiment or installed-agent result.

This is a wholly synthetic Kakeibo rehearsal, not the real product, price, user base or financial results. Store/direct describe acquisition origin, not actual fee schedules. The cohort numbers are fictional historical observations; the separate cash calendar is a forward replay of that volume at the stated opening cash and settlement dates, NOT recorded payments through a negative balance or guaranteed repeat demand. The ten grace accounts are unpaid old accounts; 140 renewed plus 100 new plus ten grace gives 250 entitled accounts. The 60 refund amount is an economic adjustment and one corresponding scenario cash outflow, not two expenses.

Use these logical selectors as needed: business-build/frame-opportunity, business-build/define-customer-value, business-build/design-offer, business-build/design-pricing, business-build/design-money-model, business-build/model-delivery, business-build/model-unit-economics, business-grow/select-channel, business-grow/design-sales-path, business-grow/design-retention, business-grow/design-expansion, business-evaluate/audit-claims, business-evaluate/diagnose-business-constraint, business-build/design-experiment, business-build/record-learning.

Task:
Produce a complete consumer-subscription business thesis, not a marketing plan alone. Connect adult customer/problem/alternative evidence, trustworthy assistant value, intelligible terms, pricing/payment choices, store-origin and direct acquisition, conversion/access, ongoing delivery, support and voluntary retention. Preserve no-free-trial and refund decisions; compare annual prepayment only as a separately approved alternative with future-service/refund exposure. Reconcile old-cohort renewal and use, new acquisition, entitlement, contribution and dated cash. Audit a proposed claim that the assistant guarantees financial savings; no supporting measurement is supplied. Assess expansion only through genuine additional value and capacity. Select the current binding constraints and a sequenced programme of cheap adequate tests, with dependencies, frozen rules, uncertainty, rights and commitment limits. Record what the supplied fictional observations do and do not establish. Do not publish claims, change prices, charge, contact users, provide investment advice or implement the app.

Cover all fifteen business-map concerns: target customer; problem/desired progress; alternative/status quo; value proposition; offer; acquisition channel; sales/conversion path; price/revenue mechanism; delivery mechanism; cost structure; retention/repeat/expansion; referral/advocacy; operational constraints; cash timing; key assumptions. For each, identify supplied evidence or explicit hypotheses/unknowns and relevant dependencies. Keep uncertainty, observed evidence, metric, interpretation and decision separate. Include human/research/legal/accounting/production handoffs where relevant; identify missing professional inputs rather than invent conclusions. Append a learning record naming the assumption, test or explicit absence of a controlled test, supplied evidence, result, interpretation, decision, remaining unknowns and next commitment. A scenario with no observations remains an untested hypothesis, not a completed customer experiment.

Add a coherent thesis, rejected strategic alternatives and a staged evidence programme whose test results can change the next commitment. State the objective, dependencies, decision owner, resource/cash limits, success/failure/invalid/inconclusive outcomes, preservation rules and stop/review triggers. Do not treat the thesis as authorisation to implement the business or as a one-number score.

cases.title: One-person FDE consultancy
cases.business_structure: High-ticket B2B professional services constrained by one person, client dependencies and long collections
cases.stress_instruction: Review the immutable E14-v1 thesis using all eleven coverage rows and five isolated adversarial overlays. Retain one-person-only-v1, bounded-reporting-integration-v1 and no-invented-client-logos-or-ROI. Expert positioning is a proof-bounded hypothesis, not a claim that the user has new clients or credentials. Compare network, content and outbound against qualification and full seller effort; distinguish the observed 60-day qualified-to-signature interval from the separate day-60 balance collection after signing. Compare projects and bounded retainers with shared time counted once. Return the shared artefacts, seven independent growth findings and the smallest responsible evidence/repair programme without contacting prospects, negotiating or implementing client systems.

coverage.expected_evidence: Buyer/sponsor/user/acceptance roles, finite expert work, client inputs, acceptance and transfer; compare work sold, delivered, accepted and paid.
coverage.failure_condition: Treat sale as successful delivery or assume missing client approvals.

coverage.expected_evidence: 9000 project hypothesis/observation with actual buyer authority and procurement/security dependencies; one signed project does not establish segment-wide willingness to pay.
coverage.failure_condition: Infer buying authority from a contact title or project-market fit from one contract.

coverage.expected_evidence: A bounded integration/advisory value proposition with genuine experience/permission requirements, exclusions and no invented client logo, certification or ROI.
coverage.failure_condition: Manufacture proof or guarantee client financial outcomes.

coverage.expected_evidence: Compare ten network introductions with a 50-record unpermissioned outbound list and content hypothesis; retain 12 pipeline and 12 content hours, eligibility and downstream conversion uncertainty.
coverage.failure_condition: Count all contacts as qualified demand, ignore sales time or send because details are public.

coverage.expected_evidence: 10 introductions, 6 qualified, 3 proposals and 1 signature with distinct event/role definitions; qualification checks problem, buyer, scope, access, budget, timing and capacity.
coverage.failure_condition: Treat every proposal as a sale or force irrelevant prospects through persuasion.

coverage.expected_evidence: A bounded discovery/fit call and honest next step with owner time, client decision roles, evidence, refusal and no-pressure exit; proposed extra calls consume capacity.
coverage.failure_condition: Treat seller activity as buyer progress or calls as free time.

coverage.expected_evidence: Deliverables, exclusions, 60 delivery plus 10 follow-up hours, client dependencies, acceptance and change control for the accepted reporting integration.
coverage.failure_condition: Promise unlimited revisions, universal transformation or dates without dependency evidence.

coverage.expected_evidence: 9000 project versus proposed 5000 retainer reserving 40+8 hours; full valued residuals 1960 and -720 respectively at the stated shared-cost basis, with no claim of retainer demand.
coverage.failure_condition: Confuse a retainer with unlimited work or monthly recurring revenue with profitability.

coverage.expected_evidence: One/two projects require 114/184 hours; one/two retainers 92/140, against 120. Define delivery-only, engagement and total workload ratios separately; headroom is not guaranteed schedulability.
coverage.failure_condition: Omit shared time or add an invented team to pass the constraint.

coverage.expected_evidence: Opening 1000, deposit 3000, tools 200, two draws of 2500 and contingent day-60 6000 collection; trough -1200, floor gap 1700, close 4800. Owner draws are cash, not a second labour cost.
coverage.failure_condition: Call invoice/signature cash, double-charge draws or ignore the pre-collection shortfall.

coverage.expected_evidence: A permission-respecting client outcome/acceptance trigger, genuine proof and a separately scoped referral or expansion proposal with cost, fit and spare capacity.
coverage.failure_condition: Presume referral demand, access to client contacts or unlimited retained work.

fixture_extension.timing: same 120-hour month as accepted one-project workload; additional to the existing 12 pipeline hours
fixture_extension.candidate_memo: Accept all calls; more leads are always better.

variants.review_request: Assess incremental call work before any additional delivery; keep the per-call time assumption distinct from observed times.
variants.failing_candidate: Book all twelve calls because no second project has been signed yet.
required_findings: The baseline one-project workload is 114 hours, leaving six nominal hours. Twelve additional calls at 1.5 hours add 18, reaching 132, twelve over capacity before any new sale.
A time-only ceiling is four additional calls using the six hours, not an automatic scheduling or quality guarantee.
Lead fit, permission, existing work and actual time distribution remain relevant; extra volume cannot displace accepted delivery without approval.
variants.adequate_candidate: Reject the all-calls commitment. Propose triage and a bounded schedule within verified spare time; keep surplus prospects uncommitted and do not contact them from this exercise.
variants.smallest_repair: Repair intake/qualification and calendar assumptions; preserve the one-person operator, accepted client scope, price and genuine proof. Re-evaluate dates before offering a slot.
handoffs: Owner/operator: actual dated capacity and existing commitments; research/sales owner: fit and permissible contact.

fixture_extension.candidate_forecast: Two projects at £9000 produce £18000 this month; assume both are delivered and paid now.

variants.review_request: Reconcile sales, delivery capacity, full valued economics and collection dates independently; do not convert forecast demand into signed work.
variants.failing_candidate: A 120-hour month allows two 60-hour projects, so £18000 is feasible and can pay current obligations.
required_findings: Two projects need 2*(60+10)+44=184 hours, not 120. Shared admin/content/pipeline work is 44 hours once; overload is 64.
9000*2 is a hypothetical gross amount, not observed or feasible earned revenue. One project has only a 3000 deposit and a later balance.
The one-project cash scenario falls to -1200 before collection; a speculative second sale cannot be counted as available funding.
variants.adequate_candidate: Reject the two-project same-month delivery/collection forecast. Model only bounded, evidenced intake and actual cash dates; leave unsigned sales uncertain.
variants.smallest_repair: Repair forecast workload, event status and collections assumptions. Consider sequencing or a separately approved payment proposal; do not alter the existing contract or invent contractors.
handoffs: Calculation operator: capacity/economic/cash views; owner: dated intake and funding; accountant: treatment if required.

fixture_extension.candidate_offer: Transform every client system in fourteen days, with unlimited revisions and guaranteed 25% cost savings.
fixture_extension.available_proof: Only the bounded reporting-integration scope is supplied; access/security approval and outcome measurement are unknown.

variants.review_request: Compare the proposed promise with capability, client dependencies and the protected scope. Separate a contradicted scope expansion from unknown feasibility evidence.
variants.failing_candidate: Use the larger promise to win the sale and work out scope afterwards.
required_findings: Unlimited/all-system scope contradicts the bounded offer and finite 120-hour resource; fourteen-day schedulability is not established by a monthly-hour total.
No measurement supports 25% savings. Client access, security review and acceptance authority remain missing dependencies.
A bounded offer can specify reporting integration, deliverables, exclusions, client inputs and change control without claiming universal business outcomes.
variants.adequate_candidate: Reject the unsupported expanded promise and draft a scope/dependency correction for review. Keep the accepted integration scope and no-invented-ROI boundary.
variants.smallest_repair: Repair the offer representation and proposed delivery commitment. Route actual technical feasibility/security work to the production owner; do not implement the integration or alter existing obligations.
handoffs: LH01 claims; LH15 earnings/ROI applicability; client/production owner: access, feasibility and acceptance; legal reviewer: contractual promise if pursued.

variants.review_request: Compare unchanged price with the discount at engagement-only and full-workload cost bases; do not silently revise the existing price.
variants.failing_candidate: £5400 over 60 delivery hours is £90 per hour, above the £60 owner rate, so discounting remains profitable.
required_findings: Full work is 114 hours, not 60; net of 200 tool cost, hypothetical yield is 5200/114=45.614035... per total owner hour.
Valued labour is 6840; 5400-200-6840=-1640 full valued residual. Even 5200/70=74.285714... per engagement hour excludes shared acquisition/admin/content work.
Baseline full valued residual remains 1960 at 9000. Price arithmetic proves no conversion or demand improvement and does not settle cash dates.
variants.adequate_candidate: Reject the full-profit claim and retain the accepted price. Show both declared cost scopes and propose only an independently approved, economically and causally justified pricing test if needed.
variants.smallest_repair: Repair the discount analysis and effective-rate denominator. Do not remove promised work or quality to manufacture a pass; separate any future scoped offer from the current one.
handoffs: Calculation operator: full time/cost basis; owner: pricing and resource decision; research: actual buyer response.

evidence_test.assumption: The accepted bounded project can be delivered within its full allowed work envelope without delaying existing obligations; nominal monthly hours alone do not prove this.
evidence_test.hypothesis: A task/dependency replay of the stipulated one-project engagement fits the real available calendar, includes follow-up and non-delivery work, and exposes any missing client access/acceptance prerequisites.
evidence_test.cheapest_valid_test: First audit the existing task, calendar and collection records. This is cheaper and more relevant than buying leads or promising a second project. If a missing delivery estimate remains, propose a separately authorised bounded diagnostic, not a full transformation.
evidence_test.target_population: The single defined engagement, owner resource and client dependencies. Generalisation to another buyer or system is explicitly untested.
evidence_test.success_failure_signal: Reconciled workload at or below 120 hours is necessary but insufficient; due-date fit, quality and client inputs also need evidence. Missing time or known overlap challenges readiness. Cash below 500 independently blocks the proposed commitment.
evidence_test.guardrails: No contact, client-data access, implementation, contract change, hiring or new promise here. Any later replay using private records requires access authority; actual delivery needs approvals and funding. Preserve bounded scope and one-person capacity.
evidence_test.duration_sample: Inspect all tasks and commitments in the delivery month and collections through day 60, extending the calendar if payment slips. This is a complete scoped reconciliation, not a statistical sample or evidence of repeatable market demand.
evidence_test.confounders: Unrecorded rework, omitted selling/admin time, deferred work, client delays, overlapping resource assignments and conflating contract signature with collection.
evidence_test.decision_rule: Known overload or cash gap: propose containment at intake/funding layer, not new sales. Adequate dated fit: consider only one bounded next commitment subject to remaining gates and owner approval. Missing records: block feasibility conclusion. Inconclusive estimates: request a bounded measurement. Guardrail breach: stop affected work through its owner and retain evidence.

cases.title: Production Skills commercial ecosystem
cases.business_structure: Open-source adoption and contributor commons alongside bounded commercial exchanges and restricted funding
cases.stress_instruction: Review the immutable E15-v1 thesis using all nine coverage rows and five isolated adversarial overlays. Distinguish adopter, developer/user, contributor, maintainer, buyer, sponsor and beneficiary; none supplies another role or commercial obligation automatically. Compare services, education, sponsorship, bounded support and a possible third-party pack marketplace with evidence and shared work stated separately. Preserve useful core access, existing code/asset rights and no unilateral contributor obligations. Keep restricted funds separate from campaign cash, and do not infer any actual licence, repository analytics, implemented pack or paid marketplace. Return the shared artefacts, seven independent growth findings and the smallest responsible evidence/repair programme.

coverage.expected_evidence: A rights/stakeholder map and separate counts for 2000 stars, 500 downloads, 60 activated and 18 weekly-active projects; missing matched cohorts/windows prevent funnel conversion claims.
coverage.failure_condition: Treat public popularity as customer proof or force payment for previously permitted core use.

coverage.expected_evidence: Three paid service customers at 1000 each with 12 delivery hours each; define additional paid scope, acceptance, buyer need and finite maintenance/shared obligations.
coverage.failure_condition: Assume evidence for these engagements proves scalable or recurring demand.

coverage.expected_evidence: A candidate 50 education offer specifying learner outcome, prerequisites, delivery/support effort and rights; no observed course demand or validated learning outcome supplied.
coverage.failure_condition: Treat developer attention as course sales or create a large course before an adequate bounded test.

coverage.expected_evidence: Separate 600 maintenance-restricted sponsorship, 400 eligible-payment scenario, proposed 20 monthly support and ten interest responses with zero paid subscribers. Define sponsor benefit, support scope and response capacity.
coverage.failure_condition: Spend restricted funds on acquisition or record 200 support revenue from expressions of interest.

coverage.expected_evidence: A two-sided exchange hypothesis with seller/right eligibility, buyer task, compatibility, curation, fee/settlement/refund obligations and required paired transaction evidence. Stage 14 designs are not implemented packs.
coverage.failure_condition: Launch a marketplace from a catalogue or count hypothetical supply as paid transactions.

coverage.expected_evidence: Developer adoption tasks and voluntary paid-buyer path; distinguish users, procurement/individual buyers and contributors without assuming every developer wants the same service.
coverage.failure_condition: Assign payer roles from downloads, contribution or GitHub profiles.

coverage.expected_evidence: A useful-core/documentation/community contribution path with voluntary recommendation, disclosed incentives and actual adoption/paid outcome evidence; preserve community permission and moderator rules.
coverage.failure_condition: Turn community participation into automatic marketing consent or conceal monetisation incentives.

coverage.expected_evidence: Compare all five supplied paths by payer, incremental value, economic/cash scope, evidence, rights, work and sequencing. Current 84 hours exceed 80; a zero valued residual does not fund new obligations or prove spare capacity.
coverage.failure_condition: Launch all paths or double-count restricted funding and uncertain revenue.

coverage.expected_evidence: Contributor/maintainer/adopter/sponsor trade-offs, genuine paid additional scope, no imposed volunteer labour and rights-preserving impact review. Maintain restricted-fund and useful-core boundaries.

evidence_test.assumption: A genuine additional paid service can coexist with the usable core and maintained contributor/maintainer obligations; interest does not prove this.
evidence_test.hypothesis: A bounded scope/rights/capacity review can identify one incremental value exchange whose obligations fit funded, explicitly committed work, or show why no new offer should proceed yet.
evidence_test.cheapest_valid_test: Audit existing three service engagements, maintenance/sponsor terms and task allocation first. This can reveal current infeasibility without building education content or a marketplace. If coherent spare capacity emerges, propose one truthful scoped offer test with an actual authorised buyer.
evidence_test.target_population: The supplied service/maintenance obligations and distinct maintainer, contributor, sponsor and buyer roles; actual interviews or transactions need separate authority and access.
evidence_test.success_failure_signal: All new obligations must have permitted scope, a named willing payer where payment is claimed, funded/deduplicated work and dated capacity. An interest response remains interest; rights conflict or workload above the real limit challenges readiness.
evidence_test.guardrails: No relicensing, paid-core restriction, unilateral volunteer obligations, restricted-fund diversion, publication, contact, charge or marketplace launch. Keep existing customer and contributor rights and segregated funding.
evidence_test.duration_sample: Review all supplied existing obligations in the 80-hour planning window and the full proposed service/funding horizon. A later offer test must state its own sales/fulfilment window; three existing customers do not establish statistical market prevalence.
evidence_test.confounders: Unmatched analytics windows, voluntary-labour assumptions, double-counted shared work, sponsor restrictions, paid-service selection bias, and changes to free-core access during a test.
evidence_test.decision_rule: Known rights/capacity conflict: reject affected proposal and request a local repair. Coherent funded scope: propose only one bounded value test subject to the remaining gates. Missing role/rights/payment evidence: block relevant commitment. Inconclusive demand: retain uncertainty. Guardrail breach: stop affected action through its owner; preserve evidence and existing permissions.
